CDC：家庭清洁与消毒指南: CDC: Cleaning and disinfecting your home
区分清洁与消毒，核对表面适用产品、通风和标签使用要求。: Distinguish cleaning from disinfecting. Check suitable products for each surface, ventilation, and label instructions.
了解清洁产品的 Safer Choice 标签及成分审查含义。: Learn what the Safer Choice label and ingredient review mean for cleaning products.
“两房一卫，打扫一下多少钱？”能换来一个数字，却未必能换来你想要的服务。对方不知: “How much to clean a two-bedroom, one-bath place?” may get you a number, but not necessarily the service you want. The cleaner doesn't know how greasy the kitchen is or whether you expect window tracks and the inside of the oven to be cleaned. Spend ten minutes defining the scope so quotes are easier to compare and the cleaner can focus on what matters most to you.
先列房间和任务，再选服务名称: List rooms and tasks before choosing a service name
“深度清洁”“搬出清洁”没有在所有商家之间统一的项目表。写明房屋类型、面积及单位: “Deep cleaning” and “move-out cleaning” don't have a standard task list across all businesses. State the home type, size and units, bedroom and bathroom counts, and whether it's empty, then list tasks by room. In the kitchen, specify counters, the stove, and cabinet exteriors or interiors; in bathrooms, scale, glass partitions, or regular wiping; in living areas, vacuuming, mopping, or specialized carpet cleaning.
把冰箱和烤箱内部、窗户内外侧、窗槽、百叶窗、踢脚线列为单独询问项。: Ask separately about refrigerator and oven interiors, both sides of windows, window tracks, blinds, and baseboards.
说明宠物、楼梯、停车及电梯预约；发几张能反映实际状况的照片，避开证件与贵重物品。: Mention pets, stairs, parking, and elevator reservations. Send a few photos that show the actual condition, without identity documents or valuables in view.
搬出清洁先看物业提供的交房清单；清洁服务的验收结果不等于物业承诺退还押金。: For move-out cleaning, check the property's handover checklist first. Accepting a cleaner's work does not mean the property manager promises to refund your deposit.
用同一份范围对比报价: Compare estimates using the same scope
向不同服务方发送同一份说明，要求书面列出包含项、排除项、耗材和设备由谁提供。按小: Send each provider the same description and request a written list of included work, exclusions, and who supplies products and equipment. For hourly pricing, ask whether it means one person's hours or the whole team's time on site. For a flat quote, ask what on-site conditions could trigger extra charges. Also check minimum booking length, parking fees, cancellation or rescheduling rules, and how extra work will be approved.
把清洁剂偏好说到产品层面: Be specific about preferred cleaning products
提前告知对香味的偏好、家中儿童和宠物的活动安排，以及石材、木地板等材质限制。CD: Discuss fragrance preferences, plans for children and pets, and restrictions for stone, wood flooring, and other materials. The CDC recommends choosing products suitable for the surface and following their labels. Cleaning and disinfecting are different steps; do not mix cleaning products. To assess ingredients, read the EPA's Safer Choice label information. It applies to products, not a cleaning company's service certification, and does not guarantee that no one will have an allergic reaction.
上门前，留好工作空间和边界: Prepare the work area and boundaries before arrival
提前收好散落物品、现金和私人文件，标出不进入的房间与不移动的物件。需要门禁时，确: Put away loose items, cash, and private documents. Mark rooms that are off limits and objects that should not be moved. If access is needed, confirm who is coming and arrange it privately; do not post access codes publicly. Walk through together before work starts to identify existing scratches and priority areas. Set expectations for stains that may not be removable rather than pushing for risky use of stronger chemicals.
趁人还在，按约定逐项验收: Review the agreed work before the cleaner leaves
按报价单查看厨房、浴室和地面的约定项目，不临时把未购买的项目算作漏做。: Check the kitchen, bathrooms, and floors against the quote. Don't treat work you didn't purchase as a missed task.
检查同意清洁的边角、设备内部和玻璃，区分残留污物与原有损伤。: Check the agreed corners, appliance interiors, and glass, distinguishing remaining dirt from preexisting damage.
发现遗漏时当面指出位置，确认能否补做以及双方约定的返工窗口。: Point out missed spots in person and confirm whether they can be addressed and any agreed follow-up window.
确认物品归位、垃圾处理、门窗关闭和钥匙交接，保存完成照片与收据。: Confirm items are back in place, trash is handled, doors and windows are closed, and keys are returned. Keep completion photos and receipts.
